headline: Spurs beat Coventry 3-1 for a first league win
whyCareReason: Tottenham left the bottom of the table. City still lead on 21 points. There is no match on Tuesday.
teaser: Maddison 14, Rudoni 49, Marmoush 58, Davies 90+6. Spurs are 16th on 6 points.
story: Tottenham Hotspur beat Coventry City 3-1 on Monday at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium. James Maddison scored in the 14th minute, Jack Rudoni equalized in the 49th, Omar Marmoush scored in the 58th, and Ben Davies scored in the 90th minute plus 6. Half-time was 1-0. ESPN, the club site and TNT Sports agree. Attendance was 60,913. Referee Andy Madley. The PA report carried by ESPN said Dejan Kulusevski made his first appearance in 526 days and Maddison made his first start in 536 days. Spurs are 16th on 6 points (1-3-3). Coventry are 17th on 6 (2-0-5). Manchester City still lead on 21. There is no Premier League fixture on Tuesday.
stakes: A first win of the season moved Spurs off the bottom. Both clubs have 6 points. City, Arsenal and Brighton are unchanged on 21, 18 and 16.
rivalryAngle: The bottom club beat a side that had already taken 6 points from six matches.
funFacts: FINAL: Tottenham 3, Coventry 1. HT 1-0. Maddison 14, Rudoni 49, Marmoush 58, Davies 90+6.
Attendance 60,913. Referee Andy Madley. Roberto De Zerbi started Maddison.
Table: City 21, Arsenal 18, Brighton 16. Spurs 16th on 6. Coventry 17th on 6.
